description: Explicit project-level context describing purpose, architectural constraints, computational model assumptions, and implementation direction.

field_descriptions.project_identity: Name or identifier of the project.
field_descriptions.project_purpose: What the project exists to do.
field_descriptions.architectural_constraints: Structural commitments and boundaries that must not be violated.
field_descriptions.computational_model: Declared computational and interpretive model assumptions. Reasoning using excluded models will misinterpret the system.
field_descriptions.implementation_direction: Preferred approaches within the architectural constraints.
field_descriptions.domain_conventions: Language-, framework-, or domain-specific conventions to follow.
field_descriptions.explicit_invariants: Rules that remain binding unless explicitly reopened.
field_descriptions.decision_record: Optional record of key architectural decisions and their rationale.
